policy: Source applications remain unchanged. Imported components are normalized to React 19 and Tailwind conventions.

entries.adaptation: Removed project CSS and converted variants to library Tailwind tokens.
Removed project CSS and retained semantic article/header/body/footer structure.
Added optional icon and library surface styling.
Removed Next.js routing, product state, translations, and app-specific shell logic.
Replaced Next.js Link with configurable anchors and legal-link manifest support.
Reused route-state pattern with library Button, Card, and ActionFeedback.
Converted tone/status pattern to Tailwind and portable state props.
Removed Next.js Link and route-specific artwork; retained responsive commerce hero pattern.
Reduced to portable product list/search/state contract.
Removed repository, image registry, and Next.js dependencies; retained availability and feedback behavior.
Replaced next/image with portable img fallback behavior.
Removed subject/auth dependencies; added generic item list and keyboard shortcut props.
Retained native details disclosure and converted styling to library tokens.
Retained controlled single-open accessibility contract and normalized styling.
Generalized learner-specific progress into a reusable labeled progress ribbon.
Converted CSS-counter step flow into configurable React 19 sequential pipeline with deliverables list.
Extracted systems capabilities cards into a responsive multi-column grid with mono badges.
Standardized principles audit table with responsive horizontal overflow and high-contrast styling.
Converted discovery contact section into standalone panel with mailto/WhatsApp actions and zero-tracking disclosure.
Converted CSS radial ring progress gauge into SVG-backed completion card with action pill buttons.
Extracted coursework calculation model into interactive assessment planner with target projections.
Converted formative diagnostic question into reusable calibration card with confidence rating and rationale reveal.
Converted repair studio drill into self-contained accordion with criteria tally and changed-facts correction field.
Ported Angular next-safe-action banner to React 19 with accessible live-region status and tone styling.
Ported Angular timesheet metrics summary into responsive 6-cell operational status strip.
Ported Angular ERP stat card to React 19 with drilldown indicators, status badge, and keyboard activation.

duplicates.decision: Excluded from the UI set because the variants contain domain-specific safety, service, and app-state logic.

platformSources.decision: Extracted delivery pipeline, capability matrix, principles audit, and direct qualified contact patterns.
Extracted coverage progress gauge, weighted coursework planner, calibrated diagnostic, and repair studio patterns.
Extracted workspace action strip, high-density metric summary strip, and interactive ERP stat card patterns.
